sections.title: Experimental Ethnography Sound: Ethnographies in-between
sections.description: Students will engage with sound as a creative ethnographic research practice, guided by a special visiting fellow at the Center for Experimental Ethnography who is a master of the craft. Sections differ in content and focus, and involve a production component as well as a final exhibit/showcase/screening.
